messages.author: eeac0a812b34e9b2
messages.subject: Error in converting gl2gi
parts:
Hello all,
I´m pretty new on bioinformatics and I´m trying to run a PCA analysis from haploid Y chromosome SNP array data in R. When I tried to convert a genlight object to genind it comes up the following error:

Error in .nextMethod(x = x, value = value) : 
  Vector length does no match number of loci
In addition: Warning message:
In df2genind(xx[, ], sep = "/", ncode = 1, ind.names = g...@ind.names,  :
  Markers with no scored alleles have been removed

Can someone explain what does it mean?

Thanks in advance,
Iriel

messages.author: b3d929c6746ca81a
messages.subject: RE: [dartR] Error in converting gl2gi
parts:
Hi,

 

The “problem” is that gl2gi is expecting diploid data in its current format.

 

Though I am fairly certain a gl.pcoa() should work on your data set from a genlight format, so for running a PCA there is no need to convert to genind.

 

Cheers, Bernd
